headword: {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}

definitions.gloss: driving under the influence of alcohol; DUI
definitions.explanation: Driving while having alcohol in one's system, even if not severely intoxicated. Under Japanese law, drivers with blood alcohol above a certain threshold but below the drunk driving limit are guilty of this offense. A lesser offense than 飲酒運転 (drunk driving) but still illegal.

examples.japanese: {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{摘発|てきはつ}→摘発：12935_tekihatsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was caught driving under the influence.

examples.english: Driving under the influence is a violation subject to license suspension and fines.

notes:
A legal traffic offense distinct from ⟦{飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}→飲酒運転：18486_inshuunten⟧ (drunk driving). {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん} refers specifically to driving with a blood alcohol concentration of 0.15mg/L or above (but below the 0.25mg/L threshold for the more serious charge).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{捕|つか}まる→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧: to be arrested for DUI
- {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧: suspicion of DUI

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}→飲酒運転：18486_inshuunten⟧: drunk driving — the more serious offense involving higher blood alcohol levels
